Callout.Name: Overheight Vehicle
Callout.Message: Vehicle has struck a bridge and is stuck.
Callout.Advisory: No injuries, load wedged, lane closed.

Script.Line: It has hit the bridge and it is wedged under it.
The roof of the trailer has gone back into the cab.
The driver is out and he is on the phone to his firm.

Lines.Approach: He has taken the bridge on with the load and lost. Nobody is hurt, the lane is shut.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
